Features Convenience Package RVQG2500i LP Generator Girard Power Armless Awning w/ Motion Sensor & LED Lighting Rear Screen/Shade Truma D Furnace/Water Heater 12V Macerator Convection Microwave Fantastic Fan w/ Rain Sensor Induction Cooktop (24FL Dual Induction Cooktop) Solid Surface Counter Tops Showermiser 30 Amp Smart Plug Sumo Spring Suspension Kit Electronics Package 12V 24' Smart TV JBL Bluetooth Stereo MBUX 10.3' Infotainment 'Hey Mercedes' Voice Guidance Navigation Back up Camera Bluetooth Radio Apple CarPlay Victron 2000W Inverter Garmin Multiplex Control w/ Auto Gen Start Sure Level Holding Tank Monitors Get Away Wifi Extenders starlink Prep 330W Solar Package Truma Aventa 110V A/C with Soft Start Side Entry Screen Door Upgraded Alcoa Aluminum Wheels Cozy Wrap Upgraded Insulation Polar Package Plus Tank Heating System Sumo Springs Suspension AWD High Gloss White More About This RV Some coaches are built to park. The 2027 Coachmen Galleria 24FL AWD is built to go. Riding on the award-winning Mercedes-Benz Sprinter chassis with all-wheel drive, a clean-running 2.0L turbo-diesel, and a smooth 9-speed automatic, this luxury Class B delivers confident traction on wet pavement, forest-service gravel, and early-season snow without giving up the fuel economy or car-like drivability that makes the Sprinter platform the benchmark of the segment. The 24FL floorplan is the flexible one: a motorized rear sofa drops flat at the push of a button and pairs with two jump seats to create a comfortable sleeping area, then folds back up to open the coach into a genuine lounge for the evening. Coachmen finishes it the way a coach at this level should be finished with hardwood cabinetry with radius doors and soft-close hinges, Q-Foam seating and more. Mercedes safety technology comes standard blind spot monitoring, lane assist, collision avoidance, electronic stability program, high beam assist, and a back-up camera and a 5,000 lb. hitch receiver means the toys can come along. Compact, capable, and finished like a coach twice its size, the Galleria 24FL AWD is the go-anywhere touring van for couples who want the trip to be the destination.
